name: @ninjapaw/pawprint
description: Deploy it. Prove it. Leave a pawprint. Reproducible Azure scenarios with portable, auditable evidence for every deploy-detect-remediate run.
author: Microsoft Corporation

scripts.portal:build: node scripts/generate-portal-catalog.mjs --check && node scripts/configure-portal-auth.mjs --check && astro build && node scripts/configure-portal-auth.mjs
scripts.portal:test: npm run portal:config:test && npm run portal:preview:test && node --check scripts/pawprint-portal.mjs && node --check public/portal.js && node --check public/shared-services.js && npm run portal:check && npm run portal:build
scripts.api:test: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix api test
scripts.config:check: node scripts/pawprint-config.mjs --check --environment dev && node scripts/pawprint-config.mjs --check --environment prod
scripts.test:identity-scripts: node --check scripts/pawprint-setup.mjs && node --check scripts/pawprint-onboard.mjs && node --check scripts/pawprint-platform.mjs && node --check scripts/publisher-public-client.mjs && npm run test:public-client
scripts.test: npm run schema:check && npm run config:check && npm run scenario:check && npm run test:guardrails && npm run test:policy && npm run test:deploy-config && npm run test:oidc-subject && npm run test:github-app-setup && npm run test:identity-scripts && npm run test:dns && npm run test:vendor-snapshot && npm run test:easm && npm run vendor:check && npm run portal:test && npm run api:test
